description: Source code for security-related functions handling X.509 certificates, including certificate initialization, path management, and retrieval of certificate properties, used within a device management context.

classes.name: certificate_profile
classes.description: Structure holding certificate path and X509 certificate pointer.

methods.name: init_certificate
methods.description: Initializes a certificate profile with a given path and X509 certificate.

methods.name: get_certificate_sig_alg
methods.description: Returns the signature algorithm name based on the signature NID.

methods.name: generate_serial_number
methods.description: Generates a serial number string from certificate serial data.

methods.name: fill_certificate_paths
methods.description: Fills the certificate paths array from a directory.

methods.name: get_certificate_paths
methods.description: Retrieves certificate paths from system and configuration.

methods.name: browseSecurityCertificateInst
methods.description: Browses and loads security certificates, creating device management nodes.

methods.name: get_Security_CertificateNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Gets the number of certificate entries.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_LastModif
methods.description: Gets the last modification time of a certificate.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_SerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number of a certificate.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_Issuer
methods.description: Retrieves the issuer name of a certificate.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_NotBefore
methods.description: Retrieves the notBefore date of a certificate.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_NotAfter
methods.description: Retrieves the notAfter date of a certificate.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_Subject
methods.description: Retrieves the subject name of a certificate.

methods.name: get_SecurityCertificate_SignatureAlgorithm
methods.description: Retrieves the signature algorithm of a certificate.
